items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Alan was in church yesterday... I wanted you to meet him

ctx.x: He's not in the church, no? Why miss me?
Well, now, Alan was in church yesterday, but he slipped up before we, before we were here. I feel like.
Oh, I see, man. So he just missed him. We just missed him there. Now, Skycar College, do you know his real name?
